title: FLA return
question: What is the FLA return, and what if it is missed?

body.normal: The FLA return reports a company's foreign liabilities and assets to the Reserve Bank of India each year. Companies that have received foreign investment must file it.
body.simple: A yearly report to the Reserve Bank about the company's foreign investment.
body.detail: The return is filed online with the RBI and draws on the company's financial statements: foreign shareholding, loans from abroad and any overseas investments. It is required for every year in which the company holds foreign investment, even if nothing changed.
body.why: Your parent company's investment makes this filing apply to you every year.

facts.v: Yearly report of foreign liabilities and assets to the RBI
Your firm prepares and files it; you approve the figures
It is treated as a breach of foreign exchange rules and needs a late submission fee to regularise.
